ambient_events: Something skitters along the channel floor and is gone before you can place it.
Water you can't see drips steadily from the culvert mouth, each drop echoing.
description: A concrete drainage channel cuts across the flats, its floor crazed and stained the rust-black of old runoff. A collapsed checkpoint booth leans over the lip, its boom gate frozen halfway down like it's still trying to stop you.
name: The Dry Wash
